answer: A protocol can bind each agent identity to a bonded stake escrowed against a rotating beacon, so a sudden tide of new registrations cannot outrun the capital cost of admission. Each identity must also present a relic of prior participation, a signed proof-of-work anchored to a willow-like merkle root that grows with honest history, making cheap mass fabrication infeasible. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
